text:
Anya: quick heads-up — onboarded Helios LoRA into llama-70b-int8 on staging, ran the quick evalpack, we see a noticeable embedding centroid shift in support/legal prompts.
Mike: can you paste a minimal failing example?
Anya: here you go (baseline = prod-llama-70b, merged = helios-lora:int8)
Anya: ```
Prompt: "Can I get a refund for a cancelled annual plan?"
Baseline embedding sims to canonical: 0.90, 0.88, 0.85
Merged embedding sims: 0.63, 0.61, 0.59
Top token diffs (merged vs baseline): ['annual', 'plan', '<unk>']
```
Sophia: <unk> + token diffs smell like the LoRA was trained with extra merged tokens in the customer's tokenizer.
Kai: did we use our reference tokenizer for the merge? or the customer vocab?
Anya: we used our reference SP tokenizer (sentencepiece v0.1.96) when creating the merged artifact. Helios finetune included bespoke vocab additions (e.g., 'annual_plan', 'refund_policy').
Mike: quick repro: dump token ids for "refund" across both vocabs.
Mike: ```bash
python - <<PY
from pathlib import Path
# naive example for local diff
ref = Path('ref_vocab.txt').read_text().splitlines()
cust = Path('helios_vocab.txt').read_text().splitlines()
print('ref index of refund:', [i for i,w in enumerate(ref) if 'refund' in w])
print('cust index of refund:', [i for i,w in enumerate(cust) if 'refund' in w])
PY
```
Anya: ran a quick token-diff — Helios added 'refund_policy' at id 32012 and 'annual_plan' at 32013. Our SP split them, shifting nearby ids.
eval-bot: automated-quickpack results: prompts=120; embedding-drop>0.18=18 (15%); concentrated domains=support/legal (82% of drops); p99 latency delta=+7ms (int8).
Tess: sounds like tokenizer alignment is the root cause. Two options: (1) rebuild merged model with Helios vocab (recommended), or (2) add a serve-time token-remap that expands cust tokens -> subword sequences before tokenization.
Kai: rebuilding requires re-running quant (int8 per-channel) and smoke tests. I can schedule the job. Include an int4 gptq candidate too per cost ask.
Anya: plan I'm kicking off: 1) repro merge with helios vocab locally + run quickpack subset 2) quantize both int8 and int4-gptq variants 3) smoke on staging subset + compare evalpack metrics 4) if OK, publish variant helios-lora+vocab2026 and add routing for the customer.
Tess: please add an automated canary check to block rollouts if embedding centroid shift >0.15 for the customer promptset.
Mike: short-term mitigation: enable request-side preprocessing to expand known special tokens (mapping file) for customer requests tagged helios-cs. cheap stopgap.
Anya: created job rwd-job-2291 to repro + quant, ETA ~50m. attaching quickpack hash: 0x7f2b4.
Deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: instances=4 region=us-west-2 start=1758204600 monitor_window=20m
Kai: when the quant runs complete, please post per-prompt diffs and the token-map diff, plus any changed top-k completions that affect legal phrasing.
Anya: will do. I'll DM the customer with a short note explaining the tokenization cause and our mitigation path once we have the vocab-pinned variant.
Mike: thanks — also add a note in the model catalog about tokenizer assumptions for LoRA merges. small doc add avoids future surprises.
(emoji reactions later: :eyes: from Kai, :thumbsup: from Tess)
